Forecast Discussion

NWS Detroit/Pontiac · 447 AM EST Sun Nov 22 2026
 

- At or near record warmth again today. 

- Light rain showers this afternoon and evening. 

- Much colder temperatures start Monday continuing through the week. 

- Potential for light snow and flurries Monday afternoon/evening.

&&

.AVIATION...

Southerly winds climbing above 10 knots ahead of a cold front today 
will lead to increasing and lowering clouds with eventual light rain 
showers spreading in from west (~20z at MBS) to east (~23z at DTW) 
late today into early this evening. Ceilings will drop into MVFR as 
winds shift to the west behind the cold front this evening. A 
pronounced mid level dry slot and wind shift to the northwest 
tonight are expected to scour out low level moisture and ceilings, 
though confidence is average at best.

.DTW THRESHOLD PROBABILITIES...

* High for cigs aob 5000 feet this evening, then decreasing 
  confidence overnight.

* High for precip type being rain this evening.
